policy.return_window: We offer a hassle-free 7-day return policy for all unused and unopened products from the date of delivery.
policy.refunds: Once we receive and inspect the returned item, your refund will be processed to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, refunds are processed via bank transfer.
policy.cancellations: You can cancel your order anytime before it is shipped by contacting customer support. Once shipped, orders cannot be cancelled but can be returned in accordance with our return policy.
policy.damaged_items: If you receive a damaged or incorrect product, please contact us within 24 hours of delivery with unboxing photos/videos, and we will issue a free replacement immediately.
